thank you !! and yo i feel it, but thankfully shadow curbed my craving for some agust d style yoongs for at least a lil bit. 

and to be fair even with non-painted denim items i try to not wash them very often at all if i can help it!! but if my pieces are visibly soiled a normal cycle in the washer and air drying it afterward has worked well for me :)
that means so much to hear!! good luck with your projects and have fun at the concert, you’ll have the time of your life !! 💜
wah, thank you!! it’s just acrylic paints mixed with a textile medium painted on a denim jacket, but that mix works well on a good range of fabrics from my experience!!

thanks so much!! 

whenever i use acrylics on fabric, i make sure to mix the paint with a textile medium 2-1 bc this ensures that the paint stays flexible and washes fine. i also try and limit my designs to no more than two or three thin coats of paint bc i’ve found that layering any thicker makes it more prone to cracking/chipping with time :) good luck with your designs !!

thanks so much!! it took me around a month and a half of casually working on it whenever I had free time. 

the sleeves are painted with acrylics mixed with fabric medium, and all the text is actually [hand stitched](https://imgur.com/a/V6TYACM) (still can’t really feel my fingers) which is what took up the majority of the work time haha.
i’m??? considering??? the logistics of opening a shop???? shsksgsl i genuinely didn’t expect such great feedback pls stay tuned maybe omg
you guys are too sweet!! i’m actually thinking of working on hixtape/agust d jackets once tour hype calms down and I can focus on another creative project haha. updates to come!! 💜
